built_bundle.description: Real Vite-built JS bundle budget (issue #831). The entry chunk (everything loaded on first paint, excluding shared vendor chunks) must stay under entry_js_gzip_bytes now that the legacy App is lazy-loaded and code-split out of the entry. The limit is set below the pre-split eager monolith entry (~120KB gzip) so reverting the lazy boundary fails CI. Every non-vendor async chunk (per-route/tab chunk) must stay under per_chunk_js_gzip_bytes. Enforced against dist/assets/*.js by scripts/check_frontend_perf_budget.py --bundle.
